comments.value: this happens too often

Just to clarify for the devs. This issue does not affect your actual avatar, nor is it reproduced to other players. This issue only shows up in mirrors and in your camera. Your actual avatar's mouth does not get stuck.
@{5c1126e60289ad7789094976|full_name}: Wait, really? How did you find out?
@{5c9c38d3f6dbdf157dcd507a|full_name}: If you look at others you can see their jaw does not hang open when they speak into mirrors.
@{5aef49599026857d34f7d6dc|full_name}: Well if it's them you're observing then you're not talking about your avatar that you are using like @{5c1126e60289ad7789094976|full_name} said.
@{5c9c38d3f6dbdf157dcd507a|full_name}: Yes I am
Not sure if this is true, I remember visemes still getting stuck locally outside of the mirror. You can test this by making the visemes affect your hands for example.

@{5adfa711a8ca626f7bf243ae|full_name}: Another easy alternative would be to use holoport locomotion, and speak, or clip out of your body by walking through a wall. It seems a more reasonable assumption that the issue is simply local, rather than specific to cameras and mirrors.
Confirmed as fixed in our latest internal 2019.2.5 builds.

Not sure if releated, but for me when I map ONLY the jawflap blendshape on an avatar, and the avatar doesnt have any blink blendshapes or anything else, The visemes just wont work at all locally, but everyone else says they see them.  Rarely, if I've been in a world for a long time, and swap avatars a few times and go back to the broken one, it will work sometimes.
This was fixed in 2019.2.5, which is now live.
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: NOT fixed. It still happens :)

@{5bb70e2661887b5d91f5b2fd|full_name}: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jzHd5IC2-u4

It is indeed fixed.
@{5adf8f221943397552bd2edf|full_name}: still happen to me lol
@{5bb70e2661887b5d91f5b2fd|full_name}: Did you update your game... ?
@{5adf8f221943397552bd2edf|full_name}: Yes i did. It still happens. Also i played with my gf and on her screen the mouth was closed. But not on mine.
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: Can also confirm that this is still happening sometimes.
Still happening occasionally, however the frequency of which this occurs is greatly reduced. On moments where I'd expect my mouth to get stuck open my blendshapes all instantly snap shut to zero.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: Now it happens every time. It's even in the patch notes that all visemes get set to 0 on speech completion, that seems to include "sil" for some reason, even if all keys are setup appropriately for VRC and eye tracking (also if they are not).

This now happens for me every time and now other people see it instead of just being in mirrors. Avatar loads in okay, after first speaking the visemes are all set to 0 so the mouth hangs open, when "sil" should be at 100.
Now every time I talk I cant see my mouth moving but others say thay can. Did this fix cause this problem now?
I still see this happening. Other users says it is working correctly on their screens, but it's very annoying to have my mouth still be frozen open on my screen.

@{5d4333334f79be298ae82a35|full_name}: This issue is marked as complete. If you wish to re-open, please create a new Client Bug Report with:

Issue Description
Reproduction Steps
Expected Outcome
Actual Outcome

and attach any video/image/logs/IDs of examples you can provide.
@{5a69eccdd20e79665351e7c1|full_name}: I see this on other people with their mouth getting stuck sometimes now too. Was only a local issue before, now seems to be a global issue.
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: How to reproduce: speak, mouth is stuck open. You really need that? really?

This still isn't fixed for remote users. It works locally but not remotely. The mouth stays on SIL for the local user but goes to rest shape for everyone else. I think someone opened another issue already, but I can't find it.

details: After talking the mouth visemes don't always properly close, instead the mouth stays partly opened. I've encountered this issue for the last several months, please fix it!
title: Mouth not closing after talking
